fact: The March 2023 evaluation of Togo's 2018-2022 health information strategy lists as a weakness the lack of interoperability of third-party data (civil registry, insurance) with the national health information system applications, and a non-digitized patient record.
title: Rapport final d'évaluation du Plan stratégique de renforcement du SNIS 2018-2022
publisher: Ministère de la Santé du Togo
